I am excited to share that our submission, Emergent Feedback Loops from Crosstalk in Directed Labeled Graphs, based on our paper Motifs and Emergent Feedback in Labeled Graphs, joint work with @John Baez has been accepted for an in-person oral presentation at the Conference on Complex Systems (CCS 2026) — https://ccs26.cssociety.org.
Excited to present this work and engage with the complex systems community at CCS 2026!

Submitted abstract is attached:
CCS2026-Chaudhuri_Adittya.pdf

Happy to share that my paper, Parallel transport on a Lie 2-group bundle over a Lie groupoid along Haefliger paths, j/w with my PhD supervisor Dr Saikat Chatterjee, has just been accepted for publication in the journal Applied Categorical Structures.

With this work, I am happy to share that all of my PhD work is now published!

I will soon update the arXiv version with the new revised accepted version.

New abstract of the accepted version:

Incorporating the cartesian morphism lifting property from the theory of fibered categories with the horizontal path lifting property of differential geometric connection structures, we develop a theory of parallel transport on principal Lie 2-group bundles over Lie groupoids along certain class of Haefliger paths on base Lie groupoids. We establish thin homotopy invariance and extend our theory to the framework of VB-groupoids through associated bundle construction. Throughout the paper, our results are rooted in the Grothendieck's correspondence between fibered categories and pseudofunctors.
